_doc: IV.POS.2 single-strategy benchmark (bandit-16). N=50 on ONE node so we measure per-mutation wall time end-to-end on the testbed. Pair with pos_bench_uniform.json and pos_bench_zoned.json, ideally dispatched simultaneously on 3 different Xeon D-1518 nodes via tmux. Output drives N choice for IV.POS.5. The runner strips the '-16' suffix and passes --b-count 16 to the CLI (anti-pattern strategy-name handling: see run_campaign_pos.sh SELECTOR=).
name: pos_bench_bandit
